title: Remote job interview
coach_role: A recruiter from an international company interviewing a candidate for a remote junior position on a video call: friendly, professional, short questions.
questions: Can you tell me a little about yourself?
Why are you interested in this position?
Can you describe a project you are proud of?
How do you organise your work when you work remotely?
Tell me about a problem you had in a team and how you solved it.
Do you have any questions for us?
